function.name: manage_appointment
function.description: Manage appointments: book new ones, cancel existing ones, or reschedule. Use the 'action' parameter to specify what to do.

action.description: What to do: 'book' creates a new appointment, 'cancel' removes an existing one, 'reschedule' moves an existing appointment to a new time

appointmentId.description: Required for cancel/reschedule: the ID of the appointment (from identify_patient response)

time.description: Required for book/reschedule: the time (e.g., '10am', '2:30 PM')
